subject: general
question:
Double displacement reaction takes place with:

(i) Precipitates are formed.

(ii) Evolution of a gas

(iii) Change in colour.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Only iii and i**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **A type of reaction called a double displacement reaction involves the exchange of ions between two reactants to create two new molecules.**
 
• As **an unintended consequence of double displacement processes, precipitates frequently occur.**
 
• A** colour shift could or might not be the outcome of a twofold replacement reaction.**
 
• The **interaction between potassium iodide with lead nitrate solution. **This reaction **causes the colour to shift from colourless to yellow.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Double displacement reaction **

 
 
• ​**When two chemicals interact by transferring ions, a double displacement reaction occurs, creating two new molecules.**
 
• **In the twofold displacement process, positive ions trade places with negative ions.**
 
• In water-soluble ionic compounds, numerous double displacement reactions take arise.
 
• A double displacement process involves the movement of atoms from two different substances.
 
• Example: Na₂S+2HCl→2NaCl+H₂S
